definitions.flops: predicated-on FADD + FMUL + 2*FFMA, and corresponding double instructions; excludes division, sqrt, transcendental, integer and address operations
definitions.occupancy: Nsight achieved active warps / maximum active warps
definitions.sm_throughput: Nsight SM throughput, busiest contributing pipeline; not fp32 peak utilization
definitions.memory_throughput: Nsight maximum contributing memory-system throughput; not DRAM bandwidth alone
definitions.fp32_peak: Nsight sustained FMA instructions/cycle * 2 * measured GPC clock for that kernel
definitions.timing: Unprofiled scaling timings and instrumented profiler/replay timings are separate
definitions.scene: 16 separated volume elements, one selected interior particle-element interaction per query; W6, fp32 numerical, 2D order16 and 3D explicit order8
